name: Nagase & Co., Ltd.
summary: Nagase & Co., Ltd. manufactures, imports/exports, and sells chemicals, plastics, electronic materials, cosmetics, and health foods worldwide. It offers resin raw materials, monomers, resins, solvents, pigments, dyes, dispersing materials, additives, urethane raw materials, flame retardants, release agents, conductive materials, functional sheets, films, adhesives, and sanitary materials. The company also provides petrochemical products, metal processing oil, surfactants and related raw materials, environmental equipment and chemicals, electronic chemicals, UV-curing agent materials, and chemical outsourcing coordination services.
